title: Read a file's name, size and type
why_it_matters: Client-side file tools all start with the file input.
explanation: An input of type file gives you a FileList in input.files. Each File has name, size in bytes and type. Always check that a file was chosen, because users can cancel the dialog and files[0] becomes undefined.
try_it: Choose a file and convert its size to kilobytes.
